title: Chapter 727
text:
The Void Star Pursuer was a direct evolution path. It retained some of its old talents and had some enhancements.

Among them, [Advanced Void Travel] had been changed to [Void Dimension Jump], and it was no longer a short-distance teleportation skill.

The Void Star Pursuer was a cosmic lifeform and could travel through space without the help of a vehicle. In the Void Dimension, they could change the curvature of spacetime and use the jump mode to travel long distances. Therefore, they could stay in the Void Dimension for a very long time. This skill was a godly escape skill.

[Void Distortion] had been changed to [Strengthened Void Distortion]. Its power had been increased, and it was easier to use. The cooldown had also been reduced.

[Void Molt]'s name had not changed. It was still a full-attribute buff, but its actual effect had been strengthened. [Void Ripple] talent had disappeared.

Three of the four old talents were retained.

There were two new talents, both of which were the core abilities of the Void Star Pursuer.

[Radiation Absorption]. The Void Star Pursuer could absorb the energy of the stars and cosmic radiation to survive and strengthen themselves. This was a basic characteristic of cosmic lifeforms.

The first use of this talent was to allow Han Xiao to transform into a cosmic lifeform. He would be able to survive in the universe without the help of any equipment, just like a fish in water.

The second use was that his cells would be able to absorb cosmic radiation for a long period of time and obtain a permanent increase in his attributes. The specific effects had not been tested yet, and Han Xiao was not sure how effective it was or if there was an upper limit.

But no matter what, this was a new and stable growth path. It was also the talent with the most potential for the Void Star Pursuer. The universe was filled with endless radiation. It was like the universe had become a buffet table, and the flowing radiation was like free pastries that could be eaten as one wished.

The other new talent was called [Cosmic Environment Adaptation]. There were countless high-energy radiation and particle streams in the universe, and the cosmic lifeforms lived in such an extremely harsh environment. Their bodies had very strong adaptability and defense. For example, the skin of the interstellar beast that Han Xiao had hunted before was so thick that it could cause one to despair.

This talent had transformed Han Xiao's body into a cosmic lifeform, providing him with impressive defense, physical resistance, harsh environment resistance, and resistance to all kinds of heat, cold, and electric shocks.

Han Xiao tested it out. His resistance to attacks had increased by nearly two levels, and his skin was gradually becoming thicker.

It could be said that this was the most suitable talent for him as a meat shield.

"A Star Pursuer's Innate Skill is inclined toward support and defense. It's very well-rounded and suits my fighting style very well."

Han Xiao was very satisfied with the Star Chaser's talent.

…

After figuring out the changes after the advancement, Han Xiao finally had time to think about the next problem.

He had been holding back his Level 220 Promotion for over seven years, and now that he had finally completed it, his strength had skyrocketed once more.

Han Xiao estimated that his Beyond Grade A limit would be around level 240. Although he was happy about his advancement, he knew that this was only one of the obstacles he had passed. There was still a long way to go.

After passing the level 220 threshold, the experience required to level up soared once more. It was an astronomical figure, and it was difficult for the army's one million players to continue.

After all, Class Knowledge and imparted skills were one-off transactions. The army players had already learned many abilities, so their consumption demand had decreased.

It was time to open up new leek fields.

The new players in Version 3.0 were all seedlings that had yet to mature. They were thirsty for skills and knowledge. This was a brand new market.

"Blue Star is the old birthplace, and it's already in my hands. However, the new birthplace of the Shattered Star Ring in Version 3.0 is not under my control yet …"

Han Xiao opened the star map. The birthplace of the new players was Planet Deirdre, located in the Gelock Star Cluster. The players who were born there were all newbies who joined in Version 3.0. To Han Xiao, this was like opening a new server.

The new players in Version 3.0 would naturally not be as miserable as the Blue Star players in Version 1.0. They were directly connected to the galaxy. Planet Deirdre was similar to a galactic transit station. It was surrounded by a Star System rich in resources. Many large financial groups were stationed there to explore the nearby Star Zones. To the players, there were plenty of missions and resources.

These new players who were born outside of the battlefield could travel thousands of miles to participate in the secret war main storyline. They could also explore on their own and use the rich experience of Version 3.0 to catch up to their levels. Or … they could participate in another main storyline.

The Crimson Tide was the main theme of Version 3.0, and the secret war was one of the main storylines. In the other Star Clusters, all sorts of huge events were happening. In the Gelock Star Cluster where Planet Deirdre was located, the main storyline that the new players could come into contact with was the storyline of the Shattered Star Ring Mercenary League.

This organization was the alliance organization that Sky Ring and the other large galactic mercenary armies had asked Han Xiao to lead them to establish seven years ago. They felt the turbulence in the Star Field, so they gathered the mercenaries of the Shattered Star Ring and formed a super large mercenary alliance called the 'Pan-Shattered Star Ring Alliance', or the Mercenary Alliance for short.

The Mercenary League had been established for a few years, and the effect was obvious. Under the alliance's cooperation, the mercenary league expanded to many Star Clusters. They accepted hundreds of mercenaries from dozens of civilizations and participated in many huge events.

Han Xiao had already participated in this main storyline seven years ago. Although he did not pay much attention to the changes in the mercenary world, the Black Star Corps was still one of the leaders of the Mercenary League and was one of the upper echelons of the Mercenary League.

"There's no need to worry about Blue Star, and Planet Deirdre is easy to deal with. We just need to expand the Black Star Corps there."

Han Xiao pondered.

Planet Deirdre was located in the Gelock Star Cluster and was outside of the army's business scope. However, with the status of the Black Star Corps, opening a branch on Planet Deirdre was a piece of cake.

He had used three versions to create the signboard of the Black Star Corps and left a deep impression on the players. He had a great advantage in recruiting new players.

With so many people discussing the Black Star Corps on the forums, even the new players would be curious about the past of the Black Star Corps and yearn for the faction itself.

Han Xiao's main goal in developing the Black Star Corps was to make it into a highly efficient tool for harvesting leeks. He did not even need to personally appear on Planet Deirdre.

If he wanted to become a Beyond Grade A Super, he had to expand the scale of his leek farming.

In his plan, recruiting the players on Planet Deirdre was an important mission for the next period of time.

"The army can help me recruit new players, and I have to start preparing for becoming a Beyond Grade A Super …"

With the shadow of the Tyrant looming over his head, Heber was his biggest obstacle. The moment he became a Beyond Grade A Super, he would have to face this strong enemy, and the two of them would definitely have to fight.

This was not as simple as dealing with EsGod's doppelganger or Thousand Shadows. He was about to face a true Beyond Grade A Super, and the pressure was completely different!

"I have to nurture Hella while doing some valuable missions," Han Xiao thought to himself.

Due to the Soul Embryo, he had sufficient reason to temporarily withdraw from the secret war and do his own things.

Not only did he have to level up, but he also had to find a way to increase his combat strength as much as possible. He had to make sufficient preparations before becoming a Beyond Grade A Super and obtain more talents to deal with the Tyrant.

Compared to others, this was his biggest advantage. He could actively obtain talents and continuously increase his combat strength without any bottlenecks.

"If only I could get a Universal Treasure …" Han Xiao sighed.

He was very envious of Sisko's Evolution Cube, but he did not have a chance to borrow it. He also wanted to obtain a Universal Treasure that belonged to him.

In his previous life, the players had recorded many records of Universal Treasures. In the later versions, there were even players who had obtained Universal Treasures. However, at the current stage, the locations of most Universal Treasures were unknown. Even if there were Universal Treasures with fixed locations, they would be heavily protected.

If it was so easy to obtain a Universal Treasure, Han Xiao would have gone for it long ago.

In his memories, there were three relatively well-known Universal Treasures in the Shattered Star Ring, and they were in the hands of three different Star Cluster Civilizations. Psyker's Evolution Cube was a treasure that he had heard of before, but there were very few clues about.

Currently, Han Xiao only knew of one Universal Treasure that could be obtained by him.

At this point in time, this Universal Treasure was most likely still quietly waiting in the ruins of a civilization.

The coordinates were the unexplored Flickering World!

"It's a pity … distant water cannot quench present thirst." Han Xiao felt a little regretful.

At the very least, he would have to wait until the Red Empire obtained the ownership of the Flickering World and built the Interstellar Field Stargate. Only then would he have a chance to obtain this Universal Treasure. Currently, he could not even go to the Flickering World.

Therefore, if he wanted to increase his combat strength, he had to start with talents.

…

The specific plan still had to be discussed at length. Han Xiao only wanted to relax now. He opened the door of the training room and returned to the cabin.

Hella was training hard in the combat training room. Only Fu Ding and Aurora were in the cabin. They were happily chatting like a pair of best friends. Hearing footsteps, the two of them turned around.

"Chen Xing, Fu Ding let you out again?" Han Xiao glanced at Fu Ding. At this moment, Fu Ding was behaving like a sissy. It was obvious that Chen Xing was controlling his body.

Chen Xing snorted and did not want to talk to Han Xiao. She returned the body to Fu Ding. Her temperament changed, and Fu Ding regained control of the body. He smiled gently and said, "She's still very afraid of you."

Han Xiao shook his head and curiously said, "I've always wanted to ask, since the two of you share the same body, do you have the same physiological needs as her?"

Fu Ding coughed awkwardly.

"Speaking of which, if the two of you are inseparable, is there no way to mate?"

Han Xiao was amused. Was this a forced platonic relationship?

"Must we talk about this topic? Can we talk about something else …"

Fu Ding was annoyed.

Aurora blinked and interrupted, "Actually, I'm quite curious too."

Fu Ding was very popular. During this time, he had become familiar with Aurora. The main reason was that the Chen Xing in his body liked her very much.

"Alright …" Fu Ding was helpless. "I'm a Psychic, and she's also a Psychic. We can simulate physiological needs … cough, and organs, and then use our spiritual bodies to interact with each other. Do you understand what I mean?"

Han Xiao:???

Damn, they were brain-mates!

Was this the same principle as having wet dreams?

I'm training RBQ in my brain?!

Was this the highest level of fantasy?!

Han Xiao's expression was strange. He pointed at Fu Ding.

"I didn't expect you to be a pervert too."

"Shut up!" Chen Xing appeared forcefully. Her face was red as she roared in Fu Ding's body. Then, she shrunk back.

Fu Ding came back to his senses and shrugged helplessly. "She's ignoring me. It's over."

So what if she's ignoring you? She's living in your body, so where can she go? Anyway, she's already in your shape … Han Xiao was speechless.

Aurora was laughing so hard that she was swaying back and forth. After a while, she finally stopped laughing. Wiping away her tears, she looked at Han Xiao and curiously said, "By the way, I just noticed that your life force has grown a lot stronger."

"You finally broke through the bottleneck?" Fu Ding's eyes lit up. He was overjoyed.

For seven years, Black Star's strength had stagnated. Now that he had improved again, it was undoubtedly great news at this juncture.

"You can say that." Han Xiao nodded.

"That's great. This way, we still have hope." Fu Ding was overjoyed.

Ever since he heard Austin's words, he had been worried about Han Xiao. At this moment, he could not help but heave a sigh of relief.

Han Xiao chatted casually with the two of them for a while and felt much more relaxed. Then, he returned to his room to do business.

He took out his communicator and sent the coordinates of Planet Deirdre to Sylvia. He told her to send someone to set up a branch there and report the situation to him at all times. As the chief administrative officer, she was in charge of this matter. Sylvia knew that this meant that the Army General valued this matter.

After thinking for a while, Han Xiao sent a message to Bennett to check on Blue Star's situation.
